This is the default configuration for Tiny Tapeout projects. It should fit most designs.
If you change it, please make sure you understand what you are doing. We are not responsible
if your project fails because of a bad configuration.
!!! DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE unless you know what you are doing !!!
If you get stuck with this config, please open an issue or get in touch via the discord.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz. BonettoR32V: 20 ns, the 50 MHz IO ceiling (contract section 7; the lead moved it from 40 MHz in the performance phase, hypothesis 102).
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
BonettoR32V (lead, 2026-10-18 sweep on the v3 seed in 1x2): 0.1/0.05 added ~320 hold buffers
chasing the margin (21 real violators) and left the core too full to route; 0.03/0.02 signs
off clean with hold slack +0.039 ns at every corner (sweep point S9). Sweep x6 (2026-10-18,
hyp 112 a85f6cb in 1x2): 0.015/0.01 with the repair and placement settings below routes to 0
violations and signs off with hold slack +0.023 ns at every corner (141 hold buffers).
BonettoR32V (lead, sweep x6): design repair without the default 20%/10% slew and cap margins
(fewer repair buffers in a nearly full 1x2 core; STA still closes at every corner) and
timing-driven global placement. With the hold margins above, hyp 112 a85f6cb (23,073 um2
synth) hardens clean: DRC/LVS/antenna/precheck, setup +1.85 ns, utilization 0.803. The
same netlist with the old settings failed setup by 1.96 ns (utilization 0.838).
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios
BonettoR32V (lead, 2026-10-18 sweep S9): routability-driven global placement checks
routability from 15% overflow (OpenROAD gpl -routability_check_overflow, default 30%); with
the hold margins above it takes global-routing overflow to 0 and detailed routing to 0.
BonettoR32V (hypothesis 004, docs/synth-cells.md): synthesis cell set and ABC strategy.
EXTRA_EXCLUDED_CELLS - each '!' entry is a deny wildcard of LibreLane 3.0.14's cell filter
(librelane/common/misc.py Filter): it takes the matching cells back out of the synthesis
exclusion set formed by the PDK's no_synth.cells and drc_exclude.cells. Together they allow
the smallest drive strengths (_1 logic cells, _1 and enable flip-flops, maj3, mux2i, ha, fah).
No entry matches a drc_exclude.cells cell (those have DRC errors and stay excluded), nor a
clock, delay, latch, scan, tri-state or physical-only cell. PnR's dont_use list is unchanged:
OpenROAD's set_dont_use warns STA-0122 once per '!' entry and ignores it.
SYNTH_STRATEGY - ABC script. Unlike the default AREA 0, AREA 2 resynthesizes with structural
choices and remaps once more for area recovery (librelane/scripts/pyosys/construct_abc_script.py).
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html
